title: Learning 'Trouble Trouble' from Mamie Smith at Entertainer's Cabaret
summary: Nash says he heard Mamie Smith sing 'Trouble Trouble' at Entertainer's Cabaret and sings it.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Bessie, Mamie, Ma Rainey: the classic blues queens
